items.text: ETR final Sunday injuries list Saquon Barkley OUT (with Tank Bigsby, DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown). Corroborated by Rapoport/Eagles report and Schefter ecosystem.
items.why: Friday final injury report and team ruling
items.implication: Eagles RB committee or handcuff spike; fade related pass-catchers slightly if script changes
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for Kenny Gainwell and any other PHI RBs; monitor two-minute/red-zone

items.text: ETR lists Lamar Jackson OUT. Rapoport and Schefter/Ravens confirm ankle issue rules him out vs Falcons; additional OL/edge outs noted.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; backup QB start, Henry/Flowers/Andrews usage shifts possible
items.opportunity: Potential volume uptick for Derrick Henry and pass-catchers if game script pass-heavy; Zay Flowers remains Q

items.text: ETR lists Breece Hall (and AD Mitchell) OUT.
items.implication: Jets RB opportunity for backups; pass game may adjust
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RB snaps and possible receiving work

items.text: ETR: Stefon Diggs OUT; Jayden Daniels IN. Rapoport/Schefter/Commanders confirm Diggs hamstring out, Daniels starts vs Giants; McLaurin trending positive but Q.
items.implication: Daniels return boosts WAS offense; Diggs absence opens targets for McLaurin/Deebo/others if active
items.opportunity: Target share expansion for Terry McLaurin (Q) and Deebo Samuel; Daniels rushing/passing upside

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including Alt/James). ETR concurs OUT.
items.implication: LAC WR target redistribution; Ladd McConkey Q but primary beneficiary candidate
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/red-zone for Ladd McConkey, Keenan Allen or others

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; pushing 'Brown Gobbler' nickname for target/gobble upside. Workload + Dolphins soft vs RBs. Also recent video emphasis.
items.why: Targets + fantasy points gobbling; elite matchup vs MIA run D
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, red-zone; Bengals WR injuries may funnel more

items.text: Broncos place WR Pat Bryant on IR; promoted Lil’Jordan Humphrey. Rapoport: short-term IR, miss next four, eligible Nov 8. ETR OUT.
items.why: Ankle injury from prior game; roster move
items.implication: DEN WR depth shuffle for multiple weeks
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for remaining Broncos WRs including Courtland Sutton/RJ Harvey involvement

items.implication: IND WR targets to Downs/Pierce/Alec etc.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes and targets for Josh Downs and Alec Pierce

items.text: 49ers: WR Mike Evans off injury report, no designation (clear). Juszczyk and Bosa OUT.
items.implication: Full go for Evans in SF offense vs SEA

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (ETR IN); limited for ankle maintenance but 'full-go'. Levitan: tough projection but expects much better role/workload than Week 4 after fan/media drag; currently 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier. Accounts for downside but gut says upgrade.
items.why: Not on final report + expected response to prior underuse; ankle maintenance only
items.implication: Stronger RB start/DFS consideration vs DET; clear lead over Allgeier in ETR proj
items.opportunity: Higher snap share, carries, possible red-zone/goal-line; monitor if ankle limits

items.text: Bears RB D'Andre Swift (hip/knee, missed some practice) has no injury designation; Kyle Monangai ruled out. ETR had Monangai OUT, Swift related.
items.implication: Swift lead back vs GB; Monangai out consolidates work

items.text: Berry loves Nico Collins @ TEN, ranks him WR8. Volume/red-zone hog vs Titans secondary that just allowed big game; matchup-driven.
items.why: Target volume, red-zone work, favorable matchup vs TEN

items.text: ETR lists Chris Olave (and Noah Fant) IN.
items.opportunity: Normal target share in NO offense

items.text: Levitan on Malik Nabers: hates saying negative on great player but long-term sideways risks stack (sore knee missed practice, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB, boomer coaching Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman). Frustration over low second-half targets noted. Not this-week out but multi-factor caution.
items.why: Knee + shoulder + QB/coaching stack + recent target frustration
items.implication: ROS caution despite elite talent; monitor practice/usage closely
items.conflict: Short-term playable if active but long-term risk flag
